payload.core_mechanism_summary: Compute left-to-right and right-to-left constraints: pre[i] = min(pre[i-1]+1, h[i]); suf[i] = min(suf[i+1]+1, h[i]); answer is max(min(pre[i], suf[i])).
payload.rationale: The solution uses two 1D arrays to propagate limits, which is a standard 1D DP, not 2D. It fits dp_1d_state better than dp_2d_state.
